message.text:
Beginning to identify which background workers the server actually starts.

The server starts only the s3presign runner. It triggers once immediately on startup and again via a 12-hour ticker. The memopayload runner exists but is never invoked by the server; its rebuild logic runs synchronously inside API handlers instead.

Webhook dispatch workers run as four goroutines initialized in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. They trigger on demand when `PostAsync` enqueues events, not on a schedule. The server imports `cmd/memos`, which pulls in that initialization.

The cron-based scheduler in `internal/scheduler` is not imported by the server or command entry points, so it is unused infrastructure.
